description: The paired machine screens of the quality remediation (RF-50), read by scripts/quality_screen.py. A screen names its population; a rule is added here, with the date it was recorded, before any take it will judge is generated.

clone.description: Voice Clone through saved voices, the path both apps use: each reference is a human clip of a pinned, licensed corpus (config/audio-qc-corpora.json), enrolled with its corpus transcript, then asked for scripts of the committed CC0 pool in its own language and one in another language.

reference-preparation-v2.question: Does preparing a clone reference with the audio file reader and one converter call (QWENVOICE_REFERENCE_PREPARATION=single-call), in place of the asset reader's own decode and resampling, harm clones?
reference-preparation-v2.arms: A: the build's default path. B: the same build with the key set. Seed set 1, each arm in its own data directory, generated after this rule was recorded.
reference-preparation-v2.requires: Two B arms on the same seeds are identical on every take (compare --expect identical); arm A is not, which is the defect.
reference-preparation-v2.margins: About 1.4 times the widest bound the noise floor reached (0.035 similarity, 0.027 error rate, 25 ms, 3 failures). At 192 takes the screen separates a gross regression from no change and nothing finer: a change that passes is shown not to be grossly worse, not shown to be better.
reference-preparation-v2.decision: ADOPT when B is reproducible and no guard's interval reaches past its margin on the harmful side. REJECT when a guard's whole interval lies past its margin, or B loses more takes than allowed. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE, and the default stays.

noiseFloor.method: The 192 takes under seed set 1 and again under seed set 2, the same build and data. A change to conditioning moves every take's sampling as a new seed does, so this is what no change at all looks like.
noiseFloor.sameSeedsTwice: 159 of 191 takes identical; the 32 that differ belong to the 8 voices whose reference the asset reader resampled differently in the two runs. The scorers gave identical values on identical samples (32-take smoke).
